[SWS_DM_00389] Skipping Forwarding of UDS message
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
If the DM returned a
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProto-
colMgr::IndicationResult
NOT equal to
kIndicationOk
from the
apext::
diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolMgr::IndicateMessage
,
the UDS Transport Protocol implementation shall NOT call
apext::diag::uds_
transport::UdsTransportProtocolMgr::HandleMessage
.
⌋
